original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹独立十五周年之际，一篇评论文章反思该国自2011年独立以来的历程，指出2013年12月爆发的冲突暴露了苏丹人民解放运动内部的深刻政治分歧。文章批评政治领导失败、腐败、族群政治操纵及制度薄弱，并援引前新闻部长Barnaba Marial Benjamin的说法称，大部分被盗资金发生在“durra”高粱采购丑闻期间。文章认为南苏丹的衰落是多年治理不善与错失机会逐渐累积的结果。

key_facts.fact: 2013年12月15日爆发的冲突暴露了苏丹人民解放运动内部的深刻政治分歧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The outbreak of conflict on December 15, 2013 exposed deep political divisions within the Sudan People’s Liberation Movement (SPLM)

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹于2011年7月9日获得独立
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: When independence was achieved on July 9, 2011

key_facts.fact: 据南苏丹前新闻部长Barnaba Marial Benjamin称，大部分被盗资金发生在“durra”高粱采购丑闻期间
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: According to South Sudan’s former Information Minister Barnaba Marial Benjamin, more than half of the stolen funds were taken during the “durra” scandal, when a large government purchase of sorghum, the country’s staple food, was never distributed.

key_facts.fact: 2013年12月政治危机导致数千人死亡、数百万人流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The political crisis that erupted in December 2013 plunged the country into widespread violence. Thousands of people lost their lives, millions were displaced

uncertainties: 文章为评论性内容，部分表述属作者观点而非已证实事实
